The '''''Gladiator''''' was a vessel that belonged to a slaver organization [[The Crucible]]. Commanded by the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Dace Golliard]], in [[3963 BBY]] it intercepted a mining ship ''[[Hot Prospect]]'' in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].
